name: Costa Rica
description: Costa Rica from its first peoples and the stone spheres to independence in 1821, the abolition of the army in 1948, coffee and green tourism.

checkpoints.name: The first peoples
checkpoints.note: Peoples such as the Diquís carved stone spheres, and Guayabo was a town of roads and aqueducts.

checkpoints.name: Spanish rule
checkpoints.note: Columbus reached the coast in 1502. A poor, remote colony grew up in the central valley.

checkpoints.name: Coffee republic
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1821. Coffee made the country prosper, and it beat back William Walker in 1857.

checkpoints.name: No army
checkpoints.note: After the war of 1948 Figueres abolished the army. Costa Rica became a stable democracy known for its forests.
